production.note: US model years 2008-2013, the LS3 base Corvette. Start: GM's release "2008 Corvette: Iconic Sports Car Recieves Larger, More Powerful LS3 6.2L V-8". End: GM Media's 2013 table lists the Corvette with the "6.2L V-8 LS3" (gm-2013-corvette-specs); the C7 followed for 2014. The 2005-2007 C6 with the LS2 engine is excluded (a different engine; not covered by this record). The Grand Sport, Z06, ZR1 and 427 Convertible are separate cars.

body.note: "2-door hatchback coupe with removable roof; rear-wheel drive (Coupe and Convertible)"; curb weights are given for "Coupe" and "Conv.". GM 2013: "two-door hatchback coupe with removable roof or convertible" (gm-2013-corvette-specs).

aspiration.note: No forced induction on the LS3 (inferred).

transmission.note: "6-speed manual" (Base and Z06), "6-speed manual, w/optional Z51 Performance Package", "6-speed paddle-shift automatic" (Hydra-Matic 6L80, a torque-converter automatic). The GM 2013 table lists final drives for "Six-speed manual" and "Six-speed paddle-shift automatic" (gm-2013-corvette-specs).

powerHp.note: Standard exhaust, SAE certified (asterisked). Quote (GM 2008 table): "Horsepower (hp / kW @ rpm): 430 / 321 @ 5900* w/ std. exhaust 436 / 325 @ 5900* w/ opt. exhaust". Unchanged through 2013: GM Media's 2013 table "430 / 321 @ 5900 w/ std. exhaust *; 436 / 325 @ 5900 w/ opt. exhaust*" (gm-2013-corvette-specs).

weightLb.note: 2008 coupe. Quote (GM 2008 table, Coupe and Convertible column): "Curb weight (lb / kg): Coupe: 3217 / 1459 Conv.: 3246 / 1473". No "est." label. GM gives one figure per body, not per transmission. GM Media's 2013 table gives "3208 / 1455 (coupe)" (gm-2013-corvette-specs).

discrepancies.reason: Model year. Both are GM coupe curb weights: 3,217 lb for 2008, 3,208 lb for 2013.
discrepancies.resolution: Used 3,217 lb because the reference model year is 2008.
